title: FIXTURE
description: Your shop, fitted out properly. A Shopify studio for small merchants whose storefront fits itself out as you scroll: shell, fixtures, wiring, signage, then the sign flips to OPEN.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · DOM Storefront · Lenis

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: logo, nav (Fit-out, Price list, Work, Care plans, FAQ) with one crimson indicator that slides between links, a live studio-hours chip ("Open · closes 18:00", computed for Europe/Amsterdam, Mon–Fri 09–18), and the crimson CTA. Becomes translucent after 24 px, hides on scroll-down, returns on scroll-up; a crimson progress hairline along its bottom. Below 1080 px: a toggle that opens a full-screen menu with a clip-path circle, focus trap and Escape.

sections.title: Scene (hero + fit-out, `#fit-out`)
sections.summary: left column holds the hero (eyebrow, h1 "Your shop, / fitted out / properly." split into masked lines, lead, two CTAs, three facts: 64 shops fitted, 4 wks door to door, €1,800 setup) stacked in the same grid cell as the **fit-out sheet** (five rows: 01 Shell · Store setup · Week 1; 02 Fixtures · Theme build · Weeks 2–3; 03 Wiring · App wiring · Week 3; 04 Signage · Speed + conversion · Week 4; 05 Open · Launch + care · Launch day; each with one line and four check chips). Right column: the **storefront** of the demo merchant Fennel & Clay (stoneware, Utrecht), drawn in DOM and inline SVG: browser bar with URL, "Payments live" chip, shipping bar, store nav with cart count, dark banner with coded vases and a headline, four product tiles (Tide mug €34, Low bowl €42, Dune vase €78, Pour jug €56), four app chips around the window (Reviews, Subscribe & save, Bookings, Email flows) with SVG connector paths, three order slips (`No. 1042 · Tide mug ×2 · €68.00 · Utrecht`…), and a hanging CLOSED/OPEN sign. Under it a readout: load time, conversion, orders, fitted count.

sections.title: Price list (`#prices`)
sections.summary: six services as shelf tags hanging from two drawn shelf rails: FX-01 Store setup €1,800 flat; FX-02 Theme build from €6,500; FX-03 App wiring €450 per app; FX-04 Speed audit €750 flat; FX-05 Conversion pass €1,200 flat; FX-06 Care plan €240 / month. Each tag has a punched hole and string, its stage, a lead time and an **Add to brief** toggle that preselects that need in the booking form (custom events both ways).

sections.title: Work (`#work`)
sections.summary: a full-width ink slab. Vertical tabs for three merchants (Fennel & Clay, Ritual Roast, Spokesmith) with arrow/Home/End keys; the panel shows what was fitted, a quote, a Before/After segmented toggle and three metrics that count between values with comparison bars.

sections.title: Schedule (`#schedule`)
sections.summary: a five-column Gantt (Week 1–4, Launch) whose bars draw in, plus a crimson "Today" marker that sweeps the weeks with the section's scroll progress.

sections.title: Care plans (`#plans`)
sections.summary: Counter €240, Shopfloor €420 (featured, ink card, "Most fitted"), Flagship €780 per month, with a Monthly/Annual toggle (annual = two months free: €200 / €350 / €650) and a rolling price.

sections.title: FAQ (`#faq`)
sections.summary: sticky heading; six questions in a one-open-at-a-time accordion (grid-rows animation).

sections.title: Book (`#book`)
sections.summary: three steps, and a form: name, email, store address (https:// prefix appears on focus), "What needs fitting?" chips (Setup, Theme, Apps, Speed + conversion, Care plan), budget radio chips, optional note. Client validation with specific messages, a one-shot shake and focus on the first invalid field; submit shows "Checking the shelves" for 900 ms, then the form wipes into a **fit-out slip** with a deterministic reference (`FX-1234-AB`), store host, chosen stages with prices, budget, rows printing one by one and a crimson BOOKED stamp. No network request.

sections.title: Footer (ink)
sections.summary: a marquee of the stage names, four columns (studio, hours with the live chip, links, small print), a giant FIXTURE wordmark with the mark.
